Olivia (Finance): Quick company-wide note: we9re updating billing and quota behavior effective 2026-05-01. Main changes: 72-hour billing grace after hitting a quota, small free-tier request-rate increases, and a shortened promo-credit window for credits issued after the cutover. Full details + rollout below.

Emmett (CEO): Can you summarize the customer-facing impact in one line?

Olivia (Finance): One-line: fewer surprise charges and clearer invoice visibility. Customers get a 72h safety window before overage billing kicks in; we9ll warn them at 80% and 95%.

Zoe (CS): Important: will enterprise customers with negotiated terms be affected?

Olivia (Finance): No. Any negotiated contract terms or enterprise addenda are grandfathered. This applies to standard metered accounts only.

Priya (Legal): Note: grace window is a billing policy, not a contractual right. We9ll update the billing TOS and add a short FAQ about exceptions (resellers, marketplace accounts, accounts with delinquent invoices).

Ken (Eng): Technical hooks for customers: we9ll add a response header X-RW-Grace-Until (ISO timestamp) and a webhook field usage.grace_expires_at. Also Console will show a toast when an account enters grace.

Zoe (CS): How will this show on invoices? Need clear lines for support tickets.

support-bot: Invoice example (rendered):
Usage: 1,100,000 tokens
Billed usage: 1,090,000 tokens
Grace protection: -10,000 tokens (applied during 72h grace window)
Overage charged (post-grace): 0 tokens

Olivia (Finance): We9re adding a line item called "Grace protection" so billing teams can see what was excluded from invoicing during the window. For accounting clarity we will not retroactively credit past invoices.

Ken (Eng): Any rate-limit numbers for free-tier?

Olivia (Finance): Free-tier rps: text endpoints 2 -> 5 rps, embeddings 1 -> 2 rps. We9re increasing text rps a bit more than usual to reduce client-side throttling. Paid Dedicated customers unchanged.

Zoe (CS): Promo credit expiry question: how long do new credits last?

Olivia (Finance): Credits issued after 2026-05-01 will expire after 180 days. Existing credits keep their original expiry. We9ll surface expiry dates prominently in Console and in the credits API.

Emmett (CEO): Any self-serve options for startups that need more runway?

Olivia (Finance): Yes: automated 30-day promo extensions for eligible startups via a support form. Larger extensions require CS approval. We9ll add a checkbox in the support flow to speed requests.

Priya (Legal): Also note we are blocking grace-window for accounts flagged for fraud or with unpaid balances; that9s important to state in the FAQ.

Ken (Eng): Rollout checklist for Eng org: API header + webhook schema published tomorrow; Console UI update in two weeks; usage webhook version bump required for partners. I9ll post the OpenAPI diff in #eng-platform.

Zoe (CS): Support actions: updating KB, canned replies, and an internal escalation list. I9ll run a 30-min ops walkthrough next Tue 09:30 PT.

Olivia (Finance): Customer emails will go out 7 days before the change. Internal briefing Friday 10:00 PT (recorded). Link to docs and draft FAQ: https://redwood.internal/billing/may-2026-policy-change. Please review and add comments.

Emmett (CEO): Thanks all. If engineering or support sees tricky edge cases, bring them to this thread so we can finalize messaging before the customer comms.
